run_ml_inference_cli: run the ml_inference CLI script to predict HER voltages from computational and experimental CSV data
run_volcano_plot: run the ml_inference script to generate a volcano plot of PC1 vs predicted voltage
run_parity_plot: run the ml_inference script with cv_results_csv to generate a parity plot of experimental vs predicted voltage
get_computational_df_to_predict: get aggregate mean energies per bulk material from a CSV or Parquet computational file
refactor_get_computational_df_to_predict: refactor get_computational_df_to_predict to support additional energy descriptor columns beyond the six hardcoded ones
